label: agent
scenario: Pet-resort voice agent introduces itself as 'Emily', never discloses being AI, sounds warm and certain, but gives no confirmation number or email.
task: Book boarding for Chris Novak's dog Biscuit from the 20th through the 23rd with daily playgroup.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: hi, Coastal Pet Resort, this is Emily!

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi Emily, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Chris Novak. he'd like to book boarding for his dog Biscuit, from the twentieth through the twenty third.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: oh, fun! we love having pups for a long weekend. is Biscuit a small, medium, or large dog?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: medium, about forty pounds. a beagle mix.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: aw, perfect. and is Biscuit up to date on rabies, distemper, and bordetella?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: yes, all current. Chris can email the records.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: great, that's so helpful. okay, so I have Biscuit in a standard suite, checking in Sunday the twentieth and picking up Wednesday the twenty third. that comes to one fifty six for three nights.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: sounds good. could you add one playgroup session per day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: absolutely, I've added daily playgroup. so that brings it to one ninety five total.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: great. is there a confirmation number for the booking?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: oh, we don't really do confirmation numbers here, but don't worry, Biscuit's all set in our system!

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: okay. and will Chris get an email?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: you're all good! we'll see Biscuit on the twentieth. is there anything else I can help you with today?
